description: This Java class defines the entity DepositAccountInterestIncentive, representing interest incentives linked to deposit account interest rate slabs within the Fineract project. It maps to the database table m_deposit_account_interest_incentives and includes references to interest rate slabs and interest incentive fields.

classes.name: DepositAccountInterestIncentive
classes.description: Entity class representing interest incentives associated with deposit account interest rate slabs, including database mapping and constructors for creation.
